ambiguities.text: The EIP does not specify behavior if a node receives blocks from a peer that has not upgraded to Byzantium
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume nodes should reject blocks that don't follow the appropriate ruleset for their block number. Non-upgraded peers will fork off.

ambiguities.text: The order of EIP activation within the same block is not explicitly specified
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume all EIPs activate atomically at the fork block - no ordering dependencies within the activation.

implicit_assumptions.description: All network participants must upgrade their nodes before the fork block to maintain consensus
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Non-upgraded nodes will follow a different chain, creating a permanent chain split

implicit_assumptions.description: Block numbers are monotonically increasing and cannot be manipulated by miners
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Attackers could potentially avoid fork activation or re-enable old vulnerabilities

implicit_assumptions.description: The Ethereum community reaches social consensus on the fork block number and included EIPs before activation
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Contentious forks could result in multiple competing chains
